scenicChapters.title: Gerlos Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 2 km this is Gerlos Alpine Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Gerlos Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1507 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

gerlos-alpine-road.story: From Krimml it runs 27 km to Gerlos; allow about 28 min of riding. The stops in between: Krimml Waterfalls and Gerlos Pass. The highest point is about 2,150 m. Gerlos Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
